verdict.rationale: Hatchet's Python SDK reference documents creating and managing cron triggers that run workflows on a schedule, and the docs have a dedicated Cron Runs page. That is a first-party recurring schedule, not just a one-off scheduled run. The supporting evidence is thin, though: one SDK reference line and page titles. Missing for 10: detailed cron configuration docs (syntax, timezones, managing schedules via UI/CLI), independent or hands-on corroboration of recurring runs.
